title: Ordinary scalar presentation and its cochain unit normalization
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, a scheme W and n≥0. Let π be the actual projection to the exponent n+1 quotient. Define finiteScalarOrdinaryReductionIso:pbcExtend(π)≅scalarReductionExtension(W,n) by left-adjoint uniqueness for their common restriction functor. For every cochain complex P of completed modules on W, the transpose of the degreewise hom of this isomorphism through the cochain pbc scalar adjunction is exactly the unit of the cochain scalarReductionExtension adjunction at P. No K-flatness or flat-term assumption is needed for this ordinary equation.

source.place: The scalar/pullback comparison on a flat-term K-flat representative in the finite-evaluation argument; Stacks Tags 07A6, 06YY and 0D6E.

proof.text: Construct the isomorphism by leftAdjointUniq for the ordinary pbc and finite scalar adjunctions. On each degree, homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identifies its transpose with the target adjunction unit. Extensionality of cochain maps proves the degreewise unit normalization.

theorem finiteScalarOrdinaryReductionIso_unitComplex (W : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) :
    let := sfExtensionAdditive l E W n
    ((pbcScalarAdjunction
        (PurCompactSupport.projection l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) W)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).homEquiv _ _
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (finiteScalarOrdinaryReductionIso l E W n).hom
          (.up ℤ)).app P) =
      (((scalarReductionExtension_adjunction.{u, u} l E W n).choose).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).unit.app P
